legal.entity: Oura Health Oy vs Ultrahuman Healthcare Pvt Ltd et al.
legal.description: Oura filed patent infringement suit (US District Court E.D. Tex. Case 2:23-cv-00396). ITC investigation 337-TA-1398 found Ultrahuman violated Section 337. Final ruling Sept 9, 2025: exclusion and cease-desist orders effective Oct 21, 2025 banning infringing smart rings from US import/sale. Commission noted Ultrahuman's conduct lacked credibility regarding domestic manufacturing claims.
Ultrahuman filed retaliatory patent infringement lawsuit in Delhi High Court. Court dismissed case, declaring Ultrahuman's failure to include US ITC determinations was willful and deliberate.
Ultrahuman filed PGR2024-00030 challenging validity of Oura's US Patent 11,868,178. PTAB initially determined claims likely invalid as obvious. Final decision pending.
Oura filed suit in E.D. Tex. against Ultrahuman and SVTronics (US manufacturing partner) for infringing five additional patents.
US CBP cleared Ultrahuman Ring PRO for import into US, allowing US pre-orders to resume after ITC exclusion ban.

No FDA warning letters or enforcement actions found against Ultrahuman. Products are not medical devices (per company disclaimer). M1 uses Abbott's FDA-cleared FreeStyle Libre sensor; Click Therapeutics partnership uses FDA-authorized digital therapeutic (CT-132) for migraine.
Ultrahuman claims ISO27001, GDPR, and HIPAA compliance per website footer.
